# A body-floating component shown, hidden and shown inside one mount flight renders two nodes with one id

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPickerProjection.spec.mjs:80` (combo, vertical) failed twice on CI today (dev push run 36235273002 at `08a84ef3be`; PR #19263 run 36237237140, attempt 1): `.neo-picker-container resolved to 2 elements`, both `id="neo-combobox-1__picker"`. The failing trace's last DOM snapshot shows both nodes as direct children of `<body>`. One is aligned (`translate(455px, 123.5px)`, width 141), the other is a fresh, unaligned mount. Locally the arm passes 10/10, and 12/12 at 4x/8x CPU throttling.

## The Problem

For a component whose `parentId` is `'document.body'` (every floating picker, menu, tooltip):

- `component.Base#show()` mounts with `!me.mounted && me.initVnode(true)`.
- `hide()` goes through `unmount()`, which sends `removeNode` and sets `mounted = false` at once.

Inside one in-flight `initVnode(true)`, nothing is mounted yet, so the `removeNode` is a no-op on main, and a second `show()` still reads `mounted === false` and starts a second `initVnode(true)`. Both flights insert, and the body holds two nodes with one id. `initVnode`'s own comment leaves single-flight to the caller ("any caller-side single-flight latch"); `show()` has none. The mirror case, show → hide with nothing after, lands the first flight's node after the `removeNode`, so a hidden component stays painted.

Reproduced, component tier, `empty-viewport` fixture: a container mounted at `document.body`, hidden, then `setConfigs({hidden: false})`, `({hidden: true})`, `({hidden: false})` fired without awaiting → **2 nodes, 5/5 and 3/3**. The same sequence with each step awaited → 1 node, 3/3.

## The Architectural Reality

- `mixin.VdomLifecycle#initVnode` holds `isVnodeInitializing` for the whole flight: it is set before the vdom round trip and cleared in `onInitVnode` or in the catch.
- A parent-rooted component is not affected: its `show()` / `hide()` go through the parent's update, one flight per parent.
- #18290 (the menu re-open race) was a different mechanism: a deferred focus-leave, not a double mount.

## The Fix

One mount flight at a time, and the latest intent read when it lands. `show()` starts `initVnode(true)` only when nothing is mounted **and** no flight is in the air, and the flight's settlement unmounts again if `hidden` turned true meanwhile. `hide()` during a flight leaves the unmount to that settlement instead of sending a `removeNode` for a node that does not exist yet.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 (component, red-first): show → hide → show inside one flight leaves exactly one node; red on dev (2 nodes), green at the head.
- [ ] AC-2 (component): show → hide inside one flight leaves no node once the flight lands.
- [ ] AC-3: the awaited sequence stays at one node (the control), and the component + unit tiers stay green.
- [ ] AC-4: `CellEditingPickerProjection` passes at the head.

## Out of Scope

- Ordering between a vdom-worker insert and an app-worker `removeNode` after `onInitVnode` (a separate channel question, not observed here).
- Parent-rooted `show()` / `hide()`.
